glossdef.p: This document is based on one or more Bills of Materials (BOMs). Each BOM may contain only software (SBOM), only hardware (HBOM or MBOM) or a combination of software components and hardware parts. The BOM Creation Period indicates the timeframe during which the BOMs were created. An older BOM Creation Period only affects the content of this report with respect to the software components and hardware parts used. It does not reflect the accuracy of the conveyed vulnerability and advisory data.
